name: How much does a tenant improvement office renovation cost per square foot in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much should I budget per square foot for an office renovation in Los Angeles, and what makes the price jump from basic to premium?
mainEntity.text: How much should I budget per square foot for an office renovation in Los Angeles, and what makes the price jump from basic to premium?

acceptedAnswer.text: Office renovation pricing in Los Angeles is usually driven by scope, building conditions, and finish level. A light refresh may only include paint, flooring, lighting swaps, and minor partition changes, while a full tenant improvement can add demolition, layout redesign, electrical upgrades, plumbing, HVAC changes, fire protection work, and premium millwork. Older buildings, especially pre-1980 properties, can add hazmat remediation costs if asbestos or lead is present. Permits, plan check, and city inspections also affect total budget. For a realistic estimate, ask contractors to break pricing into hard costs, soft costs, permit fees, allowances, and contingencies so you can compare bids consistently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Office renovation costs in Los Angeles commonly range from about $75 to $250 per square foot, with premium projects sometimes going higher. Basic cosmetic work sits at the low end, while full build-outs, structural changes, upgraded MEP systems, and high-end finishes push costs up fast.
